description: This PHP class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing CustomField entities within the OrangeHRM application. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and searching custom fields, as well as handling their associations with display fields and user data.

classes.name: CustomFieldDao
classes.description: DAO class responsible for CRUD operations and search functionalities related to CustomField entities in the database.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Saves a CustomField entity, assigning a field number if necessary, and creates associated display fields and display groups.

methods.name: addCustomFieldToDisplayField
methods.description: Creates and persists a DisplayField associated with a CustomField for UI display configuration.

methods.name: getCustomFieldById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomField entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCustomFieldIds
methods.description: Checks which custom field IDs already exist in the database.

methods.name: deleteCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes multiple CustomField entities and their associated display fields within a transaction.

methods.name: deleteDisplayFieldsOfCustomFields
methods.description: Removes display fields associated with specified custom field IDs.

methods.name: searchCustomField
methods.description: Performs a search for CustomField entities based on specified filters using pagination.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginated query for searching CustomFields with optional filters.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of CustomFields matching search filters.

methods.name: isCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if a specific custom field is currently in use by any employee records.

methods.name: updateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Clears the custom field value for employees where the value matches the specified drop-down option.
